modules.summary: BOM, Work Order, Job Card, Routing, Workstation

modules.name: CRM

modules.name: Buying
modules.summary: Supplier, RFQ, Purchase Order, Supplier Quotation, Scorecard

modules.name: Setup
modules.summary: Company, fiscal year, employee, holiday list, email digest, setup wizard

modules.name: EDI
modules.summary: Code List, Common Code (UN/CEFACT master data)

modules.name: Regional

files.name: accounts_controller.py
files.role: Base class for any GL-posting document; posting date, currency, tax orchestration, payment schedule

files.name: buying_controller.py
files.role: Purchase-side shared validation, party defaults, pricing

files.name: selling_controller.py
files.role: Sales-side shared validation, party defaults, pricing rules

files.name: stock_controller.py
files.role: Anything that emits Stock Ledger Entries

order_to_cash: Delivery Note (-> Stock Ledger Entry, Bin)
Sales Invoice (-> GL Entry, Payment Ledger Entry)
Payment Entry (-> GL Entry, settles AR)
procure_to_pay: Purchase Receipt (-> Stock Ledger Entry, Bin)
Purchase Invoice (-> GL Entry, Payment Ledger Entry)
Payment Entry (-> GL Entry, settles AP)
bank_reconciliation: Bank Reconciliation Tool -> link Bank Transaction to Payment Entry/Journal Entry/Invoice
core_data_flows.accounting_dimensions: Accounting Dimension records flow into every GL Entry, Payment Ledger Entry, and ~50 transaction doctypes via accounting_dimension_doctypes in hooks.py

ledgers.name: GL Entry
ledgers.role: Append-only journal lines; canonical truth for trial balance / P&L / BS

ledgers.name: Payment Ledger Entry
ledgers.role: Per-party AR/AP perspective ledger; powers receivable/payable reports

ledgers.name: Stock Ledger Entry
ledgers.role: Append-only stock movements; valuation derived from this

ledgers.name: Account Closing Balance
ledgers.role: Period Closing Voucher snapshot of P&L into RE

principles: Submitted Purchase Invoice + submitted Payment Entry + outstanding_amount=0 + status=Paid means the AP is settled.
Bank Transaction is independent of Payment Entry — settlement and reconciliation are separate signals.
Accounting Period locks block validate/save on the 17 period_closing_doctypes once a period is closed.

frontend.portal_routes: hooks.py:website_route_rules (orders, invoices, supplier quotations, POs, RFQs, addresses, shipments, BOMs, timesheets, material requests, projects, tasks)

extension_points: Add DocType JSON + Document subclass under erpnext/<module>/doctype/<name>/

fork_overlay.summary: AP Closed Loop Receipt Processing pilot — narrow vertical slice for invoice intake -> OCR proposal -> AP review -> validation -> Purchase Invoice promotion -> approval routing -> mock Payment Entry -> closure evidence.
modified_paths: erpnext/setup/utils.py (Role enumeration switched from frappe.db.get_values to frappe.get_all)
principles: Purchase Invoice is the canonical payable invoice (native doctype, not replaced).
Payment Entry is the payment/closure anchor (native doctype, not replaced).
No Bank Transaction is created; no bank-reconciliation implied.
No custom 'closed' flag is stored; closure is derived from native state.
Provider / payment artifacts are explicitly labeled MOCK and must not be mistaken for a real banking integration.
